requirementFit.summary: REQ-FE-AI maps to AC-AI-UI-1/2, EV-AI-UI-1/2, the single WS-FE-AI workstream, security gates SEC-HTML/SEC-URL and the final audit gates; the searching/typing/success/empty/error state machine, safe document cards and the rendering-safety boundary are explicit.

implementationQuality.summary: The 3-path write set (feature directory incl. colocated tests, features/index.ts and main.ts with strictly-additive contracts per the stage-4 ownership-move precedent) plus leadOwned artifacts cover everything the implementation must touch; kernel, utils, shared components, the auth/chats/profile features, backend and npm metadata stay forbidden with zero new dependencies.

evidenceQuality.summary: EV-AI-UI-1/EV-AI-UI-2 are provable by npm run verify with fake ports and jsdom (state machine, URL rejection matrix, text-escaping and template assertions); the browser checklist records honest UNAVAILABLE rows without a live owned backend/Ollama and is never converted to PASS.

residualRisk.summary: Round-1 findings (HIGH: absolute triple-stache ban contradicted the only component-nesting mechanism; MEDIUM: undeclared stylesheet load path; four LOW: is_ai fact, module.ts enumeration, Store typing, checklist recordability) were all closed in r3 and re-verified by the focused round 2; no open findings remain.

summary: Independent two-round read-only audit of the refrozen stage 10 package. Round 1 (r2) returned CHANGES_REQUIRED with one HIGH finding - the absolute triple-stache ban made the plan's own component design unimplementable because registerComponent helpers emit raw HTML and every existing page nests components through triple-stache - plus a MEDIUM undeclared stylesheet load path and four LOW findings (inaccurate is_ai base-tree fact, missing module.ts in the enumeration, absent Store typing guidance for the closed AppState, checklist rows unrecordable without a live backend). Round 1 also verified the architecture as a whole against the real tree: the composition move of features/index.ts and main.ts into the write-set is precedented and the only way to a reachable feature, all consumed stage 8/9 REST contracts match the backend paths and payload shapes, joinUrl structurally guarantees the URL safety seam, guard ranks make the planned imports legal, and the ALK mechanics follow the frozen stage precedents. Round 2 (r3, focused) verified every closure landed exactly as declared - the rendering invariant rescoped to wire data with a matching deterministic template assertion, the feature-local scss import path through the existing vite/client declaration, the corrected is_ai fact with own-port DTOs, the named module.ts, the chatsSlice cast idiom for Store typing and the honest UNAVAILABLE-capable checklist rows - and found no regressions in JSON validity, planFiles inventory, write-set disjointness or cross-references. Verdict: READY_TO_FREEZE.
